Miami-Dade County Florida Inmate Lookup — Official Guide

If you're searching for information about an inmate in Miami-Dade County, Florida, the official jail records database provides public access to custody details for individuals detained in county facilities. Understanding how to navigate the Miami-Dade County inmate lookup system can help you quickly find the information you need.

How to Search Miami-Dade County Jail Records

  1. Visit the official Miami-Dade County Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation inmate search portal online.
  2. Enter the inmate's full name or booking number in the designated search field.
  3. Select the appropriate date range if the inmate's current custody status is unknown.
  4. Review the search results, which typically display the inmate's name, booking number, custody status, and facility location.
  5. Click on the inmate's record to access detailed information including charges, bail amounts, and court dates.
  6. Print or save the record for your personal reference or legal proceedings.

Official Miami-Dade County Resources

  • Miami-Dade County Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation — Main inmate database and custody records
  • Miami-Dade County Clerk of Courts — Criminal case information and court schedules
  • Miami-Dade Police Department — Arrest records and incident reports
  • Florida Department of Corrections — Information for state prison inmates
  • Miami-Dade County Public Defender's Office — Legal representation resources

Bail Information for Miami-Dade County Florida

Bail amounts in Miami-Dade County are determined by judges based on the severity of charges, criminal history, ties to the community, and flight risk. Inmates may be released on their own recognizance, with bail set by the court, or held without bail for serious felonies. Family members can contact the bail bonds office or a licensed bail bondsman to arrange release. The Miami-Dade County Corrections Department provides information about bail hearings, and the clerk of courts maintains records of all bail decisions and bond postings.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to update the Miami-Dade County inmate database?

The inmate lookup system is typically updated within 1-2 hours of booking. However, some information may take longer to appear in the system, particularly during high-volume booking periods.

Can I find information about inmates in federal facilities through Miami-Dade County records?

No. The Miami-Dade County inmate lookup only provides information about individuals detained in county jail facilities. Federal inmates are searchable through the Federal Bureau of Prisons inmate locator.

What documents do I need to visit an inmate at Miami-Dade County jail?

Visitors must present a valid government-issued photo ID. Contact the specific detention facility in advance for visitation hours, approved visiting days, and any additional requirements or restrictions.
